deep.reconstruction:
Context: magnetometer work from the 1830s (bundle on induction; previous page treats a multiplier/galvanometer, next page the damping force, 'Beruhigungskraft', of bar C). This page reduces readings of a freely swinging magnet to its equilibrium (rest) position, in two series, and compares the result with simultaneous readings from a second scale or instrument.

(1) Upper series. The time column reads 49m 52s, 87s, 122s and 50m 8s, 43s, 78s. The readings are spaced Δt = 35 s apart; Gauss lets the seconds run past 60. Each of six columns holds six scale readings x1..x6 taken at these instants. The readings trace one full oscillation over six samples, so the period is T ≈ 6·35 = 210 s. Readings three samples apart are therefore half a period apart and lie on opposite sides of the rest point.

Rest position (my explicit formulation):
- r1 = (x1+x4)/2, r2 = (x2+x5)/2, r3 = (x3+x6)/2.
- R = (r1+r2+r3)/3.

Column 1 (minute 39): readings 977.0, 972.8, 975.7, 983.5, 988.3, 985.8.
- r = 980.25, 980.55, 980.75; R = 980.517 → 980.52.

Column 2 (41): readings 979.1, 986.1, 987.5, 981.8, 974.9, 972.8.
- r = 980.45, 980.50, 980.15; R = 980.37.

Column 3 (43): r = 978.95, 978.70, 978.60; R = 978.75.
Column 4 (45): r = 978.55, 978.45, 978.10; R = 978.37.
Column 5 (47): r = 977.50, 977.25, 977.20; R = 977.32.
Column 6 (49): r = 977.00, 976.75, 976.70; R = 976.82.

Below each R stands a second reading (655.57, 655.31, 653.59, 653.04, 652.05, 651.52), presumably the simultaneous position on another instrument or scale. The differences R − S are 324.95, 325.06, 325.16, 325.33, 325.27, 325.30. Both instruments drift by about 4 units over the ten minutes while the difference stays nearly constant (about 324.95 to 325.33). This is a comparison or calibration of the two readings.

(2) Lower series. The time column carries '1h 10' 52"' (with '87') and then 4h 46m 49s, 84s, 119s and 41m 5s, 40s, 75s, again at 35 s spacing. Four complete columns (minutes 36, 38, 40, 42) and a fifth incomplete one are reduced the same way.
- Column 36: r = 980.1, 979.9, 979.9; R = 979.97.
- Column 38: r = 980.1, 979.95, 980.15; R = 980.07.
- Column 40: r = 980.2, 980.25, 980.05; R = 980.17.
- Column 42: r = 980.2, 980.2, 980.25; R = 980.22 (no comparison value written).

Comparison values: 655.72, 655.97, 655.97. Differences: 324.25, 324.10 and 324.10 (the last should be 324.20, see errors). The fifth column (977.4, 979.0, 981.?, then ditto marks) is not reduced.

The header notes '36.0', '46.56,08' and 'Phys. 4' are bookkeeping or time references; their meaning is uncertain.
errors: Lower series, third column (minute 40): 980.17 − 655.97 = 324.20, but 324,10 is written. Either the subtraction slipped, or the comparison value (read as 655.97, perhaps copied from the column before) is wrong.
All other means, rounding and differences check correctly; intermediate means are rounded to two decimals (e.g. 980.517 → 980.52, 978.367 → 978.37).

results.what: Equilibrium position of an oscillating magnet from scale readings taken at intervals of T/6, averaging readings half a period apart and then averaging the three pair-means
results.modern_name: Rest-point determination from turning or phase readings (Gauss–Weber magnetometer reading method)
results.usually_credited_to: Gauss (and Weber), Intensitas vis magneticae (1832/33) and Resultate aus den Beobachtungen des magnetischen Vereins (1836 ff.)

results.what: Differencing simultaneous rest positions of two instruments to compare their variation readings

deep.surprise_reason: These are routine observational reductions of magnetometer readings using Gauss's own well-known method; there is no new mathematics.
transcription_corrections: Upper series: the column-1 third reading 975.7 is confirmed by the pair-mean 980.75. The pair-means under columns 39 and 41 are abbreviated in the manuscript ('55', '75'; '50', '15'), meaning 980.55, 980.75 and 980.50, 980.15.
The lower time column reads '4. 46 49, ·84, ·119, 41 5, 40, 75' (seconds counted past 60, at 35 s steps), headed by '1h 10' 52"' with '87' below.
Lower fifth column: 977.4, 979.0, 981.(?) followed by ditto-like '9' marks; it is not reduced.
The third lower comparison value reads 655.97 (or possibly a miscopy). With the written difference 324,10 it is inconsistent with the mean 980.17.
